title: Rethinking Dead Block Prediction for Intermittent Computing
problem: Existing dead block predictors, designed for conventional always-on systems, are ineffective in energy-harvesting intermittent computing systems because they do not account for power failures that invalidate cache blocks before they can be reused, causing unnecessary leakage energy waste on blocks that are nominally 'live' but will be lost.
motivation: Energy-harvesting devices (e.g., RFID, IoT sensors) execute intermittently with frequent power failures; preserving cache energy is critical for forward execution progress, but conventional dead block predictors misidentify power-failure-doomed live blocks as worth keeping.
method: EDBP (Enhanced Dead Block Predictor) augments existing dead block predictors with a power-failure-aware prediction layer. It identifies cache blocks that, though predicted live by a conventional predictor, are unlikely to be accessed before the next anticipated power failure. These blocks are deactivated (gated off) to eliminate leakage energy, freeing energy budget for forward execution. EDBP is combined with the Cache Decay predictor to achieve near-theoretical-minimum cache leakage across 20 Mediabench and MiBench applications.
key_novelty: Incorporating power failure prediction into dead block identification, enabling leakage reduction for blocks that are live under a conventional model but unreachable due to imminent energy exhaustion.
contributions: EDBP framework that extends dead block predictors with intermittence-aware block deactivation for energy-harvesting systems.
6.5% total energy reduction and 6.9% performance improvement using EDBP alone versus no dead block predictor.
9.8% total energy reduction and 11.9% performance improvement when EDBP is combined with Cache Decay, approaching the theoretical minimum.

metrics.other: 11.9% performance improvement; 6.5% energy reduction standalone; 20 Mediabench/MiBench applications

limitations: The power-failure prediction model relies on empirically estimated energy thresholds that may not generalize across different harvesting environments or supply voltage profiles.
primary_theme: Power-failure-aware cache dead block prediction for intermittent energy-harvesting systems
